backup.production_rule: Guest guide v9 backend (s137), additive only, built on the live guide v8 session system: one table guide_staff_sessions (RLS on, no policy, no privilege for anon, authenticated or service_role, never more than 50 rows); three functions guide_staff_session_v1(text, text), guide_secrets_v1(text), get_public_settings() (SECURITY DEFINER, search_path empty, executable by anon and authenticated only, not by service_role or PUBLIC); one pg_cron job weather-proxy-warm every 10 minutes calling the weather-proxy edge function with net.http_get. No existing table, function or policy is changed; verify_admin_pin is called, not replaced; app_settings is read, never written.
backup.notes: Apply after guide_v8_messages_analytics (20261206000000) and s136_followups (20261206100000) are live (both are, 2026-11-25). The migration carries no begin/commit (the runner wraps it). Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs; the checker refuses one older than an hour). The migration guard raises 55000 where guide v8 or verify_admin_pin is missing or guide_staff_sessions already exists. STORAGE: the one new table is bounded at 50 rows by the mint itself (expired rows deleted inline, mint refused above 50 live rows), a few kilobytes; pg_net keeps its own response log, which it trims itself.

forward_verification.name: staff_sessions_table_rls_on
forward_verification.query: select coalesce((select c.relrowsecurity from pg_class c where c.oid = to_regclass('public.guide_staff_sessions')), false)

forward_verification.name: staff_sessions_no_client_privileges
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.guide_staff_sessions') is not null and not exists (select 1 from unnest(array['anon','authenticated','service_role']) r, unnest(array['select','insert','update','delete','truncate','references','trigger']) p where has_table_privilege(r, 'public.guide_staff_sessions', p))

forward_verification.name: three_functions_definer_search_path_pinned
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig @> array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('guide_staff_session_v1','guide_secrets_v1','get_public_settings')

forward_verification.name: anon_and_authenticated_execute_service_role_not
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', f, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', f, 'execute')) from unnest(array['public.guide_staff_session_v1(text,text)','public.guide_secrets_v1(text)','public.get_public_settings()']::regprocedure[]) f

forward_verification.name: public_has_no_execute
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from unnest(array['public.guide_staff_session_v1(text,text)','public.guide_secrets_v1(text)','public.get_public_settings()']::regprocedure[]) f join pg_proc p on p.oid = f cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a where a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: mint_lock_timeout_and_read_functions_stable
forward_verification.query: select (select p.proconfig @> array['lock_timeout=2s'] and p.provolatile = 'v' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.guide_staff_session_v1(text,text)'::regprocedure) and (select p.provolatile = 's' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.guide_secrets_v1(text)'::regprocedure) and (select p.provolatile = 's' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.get_public_settings()'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: bad_token_refused
forward_verification.query: select public.guide_secrets_v1(repeat('0', 64)) = '{"ok": false}'::jsonb and public.guide_secrets_v1(null) = '{"ok": false}'::jsonb

forward_verification.name: public_settings_whitelist_only
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(public.get_public_settings()) k where k <> all (array['wifi_ssid','house_times','min_nights','max_nights','review_airbnb_url','review_facebook_url','review_google_url','property_lat','property_lng','concierge_mode'])) = 0 and not jsonb_exists(public.get_public_settings(), 'wifi_password') and not jsonb_exists(public.get_public_settings(), 'admin_pin_hash') and not jsonb_exists(public.get_public_settings(), 'onground_phone')

forward_verification.name: weather_warm_job_scheduled
forward_verification.query: select case when to_regclass('cron.job') is null then true else (xpath('/row/c/text()', query_to_xml('select count(*) as c from cron.job where jobname = ''weather-proxy-warm'' and schedule = ''*/10 * * * *'' and command like ''%/functions/v1/weather-proxy%'' and command like ''%net.http_get%''', false, true, '')))[1]::text::int = 1 end

rollback.safe_until: Any time. The rollback unschedules weather-proxy-warm, drops the three functions and the guide_staff_sessions table. Guide v8 and verify_admin_pin are not touched. Staff tokens die with the table (staff sign in again); guest tokens are guide v8 sessions and are untouched.

steps.name: rollback_clients_first
steps.action: Revert the guide v9 frontend first (it calls the new functions); until then the guide shows the stay secrets as unavailable.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261207_guide_v9_secrets.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; then select count(*) from pg_proc where proname in (guide_staff_session_v1, guide_secrets_v1, get_public_settings) must read 0 and cron.job must hold no weather-proxy-warm.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. Additive: the live guide keeps working without this SQL. The guide v9 frontend needs it first. To make the secrets actually private the frontend must stop reading wifi_password, onground_name and onground_phone from app_settings and a separate, later change must close the anon read policy on those keys (see docs/s137/GUIDE-V9-SECRETS.md, finding F1).

compatibility.evidence: Rehearsed 2026-11-25 on host alfred on a restored copy of production backup cascade-supabase-20261125T004039Z (142 public tables, 237 ledger rows; it predates guide v8 and s136_followups, so both were applied first in the same container, as in production today). Sequence in one container: guide v8 and s136_followups, snapshot (fingerprint of every non-v9 table, function body, ACL, default privilege and the public schema ACL), apply 20261207000000_guide_v9_secrets.sql (sha256 recorded in this contract), the 10 forward checks, fingerprint of the v9 objects, rollback supabase/rollbacks/20261207_guide_v9_secrets.sql with checks (no guide_staff_sessions, no v9 function, public table count and the non-v9 fingerprint identical to the snapshot, so guide v8 is untouched), apply again, the 10 forward checks again and the v9 fingerprint identical to the first apply: 8 migrations applied, 0 failed; forward verification 10 passed, 0 failed (log .rehearsal-logs/rehearsal-guide_v9-post-full.log, exit 8 only because of the accepted_failing_tests baseline). pgTAP guide_v9_secrets 47 of 47, guide_v8_messages_analytics 172 of 172, s136_followups 41 of 41; the seven baseline suites fail exactly the numbers in accepted_failing_tests and none else, and the same numbers failed in the run without this migration (rehearsal-guide_v9-pre-full.log). Mutation check (ML-70, logs .rehearsal-logs/rehearsal-guide_v9-mut-A..F.log, mutants made by an untracked script): A (throttle key = p_client only) fails tests 21, 22, 23; B (cap 50 -> 5000) fails 35-39; C (wifi_password added to the whitelist) fails the forward check public_settings_whitelist_only in the harness before the suite runs; D (staff expiry check removed) fails 30, 31; E (expired rows not deleted on mint) fails 33, 34, 36-39; F (wifi_password read from wifi_ssid) fails 14, 16, 28. pg_cron and pg_net are absent from the rehearsal copy, so the weather-proxy-warm job was NOT scheduled there (the check passes by the absent-cron branch): its schedule is checked after the production apply by the verify script and post_apply_check. The harness files ran as temporary untracked migrations that were deleted afterwards; nothing temporary is in git.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the migration guard raises 55000 (guide v8 helper or sessions table, verify_admin_pin or app_settings missing, or public.guide_staff_sessions already exists)

the rehearsal has not run the migration (apply, rollback, apply again, forward checks after each) and the suite guide_v9_secrets on this commit, or any test fails outside the accepted_failing_tests lists, or compatibility.verified is still false
the weather-proxy edge function answers 401 or 403 to a request with no headers (the warm-up sends none; the guide sends none)
post_apply_check: Read-only, orchestrator PC, right after the apply: run supabase/sql/2026-12-07-guide-v9-verify.sql through run-sql-on-host.sh (10 rows, all t). Then one call of guide_secrets_v1 with a live guest token from the guide and one with a garbage token (ok true with kind guest, and {"ok": false}); never print the values. Staff mint: call guide_staff_session_v1 from the guide with the real PIN, read the token only into the guide. After about 10 minutes select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname = weather-proxy-warm, and one curl of the weather-proxy URL with no headers must answer 200 in under 2 seconds.

function_contract: guide_secrets_v1(p_token text): {"ok":false} for any null, malformed, unknown or expired token; else {"ok":true,"kind":"guest"|"staff","wifi_ssid","wifi_password","onground_name","onground_phone"} (a setting that does not exist is JSON null).

guide_staff_session_v1(p_code text, p_client text default null): returns the verify_admin_pin json unchanged ({"ok":false}, {"ok":false,"throttled":true}, or {"ok":true,"users":[...]}); on ok adds "token" (64 hex, 12 hours) and "expires_at"; at 50 live sessions or on a lock timeout it adds "reason":"busy" and no token.

get_public_settings(): one jsonb object holding only wifi_ssid, house_times, min_nights, max_nights, review_airbnb_url, review_facebook_url, review_google_url, property_lat, property_lng, concierge_mode (a key that is not set is left out).
notes.whitelists: The ten get_public_settings keys are listed in the function body and in the forward check public_settings_whitelist_only; adding a key means changing both.
